t.ISA.44.5: One will say, ‘I belong to the LORD,’ another will call himself by the name of Jacob, and still another will write on his hand, ‘The LORD’s,’ and will take the name of Israel.”
t.2TI.4.22: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you all.
t.ROM.16.20: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
t.PHM.1.25: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
t.REV.22.21: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all the saints. Amen.
